contradictions.note: Same source/target with depends_on AND contrasts_with
contradictions.resolution: LEGITIMATE — Aristotle (DA III.3) distinguishes phantasia FROM aisthesis as categorically distinct faculties (contrasts_with), but phantasia cannot function without prior sense-perception and depends causally on it (depends_on). The contrast is taxonomic; the dependency is causal. Both edges are textually grounded and philosophically correct.

contradictions.resolution: LEGITIMATE — Heidegger (B&T S33) argues the Apophantical-As is a derivative, narrowed form of the Hermeneutical-As. It contrasts with it in scope (theoretical predication vs. pre-theoretical understanding) but depends on it as its condition of possibility (the apophantical is derived from the hermeneutical). Both edges are textually grounded and philosophically correct.
